points.why: It names the vacancies, overtime, burnout, resignations, vacancies reinforcing loop and shows mandatory overtime as the cheap fix that feeds it.
It places (a) as a parameter on quitting, (b) as a rule cutting the overtime-to-burnout link, and (c) as the goal that makes overtime look right.
It notes (c) may need an outside body and the bonus is weak, but never explicitly rates power against reach or suggests testing options in a model.
It chooses clearly, labels the bonus a stopgap buying time for (b) and (c), and flags the answer-time dip during the transition.

pitfalls.why: It keeps the bonus as a targeted bridge and makes the cap central rather than dismissing either.
